verdict.rationale: Vonage Video API documents registrable server-side HTTP callbacks for session and stream activity across all sessions in a project. It also supports archive event callbacks and session rotation notifications, and webhook requests can be secured with signed callbacks. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented retry/delivery semantics and full event payload schemas.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Register to receive real-time session event callbacks and monitor your session activity from your app server.
Server endpoints can also register to receive HTTP requests triggered by stream activity on all sessions for a given project.
Additionally, you can register a callback to monitor events related to Vonage Video archives for your project.
You can secure webhook callback requests with signed callbacks, using a signature secret.
